messages:
Maria G: Quick follow-up on the quant-profiles RFC — especially the handoff pattern between eng-ml (profiles) and eng-runtime (adaptor). I sketched a minimal surface: 3 quality tiers -> {high: FP8, balanced: INT8, eco: 4-bit} with an explicit fallback chain. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Kevin L: Do we add a new request header or extend the infer API body? My vote: opt-in field in request metadata so SDKs can default. Example request: 
```json
{"quant_profile": "balanced-v2", "fallback": ["high","balanced","eco"]}
```
Ashok R: runtime notes — per-request negotiation is fine but must be O(1) in the hot path. Recommend numeric profile IDs + bitflags so kernel selection is a simple index lookup. KV cache invalidation on bitwidth changes is the tricky bit — need sticky cache keys or prefix-namespace to avoid cross-bit pollution.
Sophie T: From QA: we need explicit acceptance tests per profile using our canonical prompt set + a focused adversarial suite. Also define degradation guardrails, e.g. token-level log-likelihood delta and per-endpoint quality budgets. Shadow sampling is required before any canary.
Zach P: Ops concerns — rollout plan should be: feature-flagged canary (1%), then 10%, then 100% with automatic rollback if token_loss_delta > 0.5% or latency tail SLO breaks. Telemetry: collect token_loss_delta, median/95/99 latency, cost_savings_pct, fallback_rate. Correlate by customer and route.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: quant-adaptor v0.3 -> staging (link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/quant-adaptor/123) :rocket:
Maria G: Thanks. Action items: (1) Ashok -> define numeric ID scheme + KV cache strategy; (2) Sophie -> test plan and pass/fail thresholds; (3) Kevin -> SDK field/compat spec; (4) Zach -> telemetry + alert thresholds. Can we sync tomorrow 10am PT? :thumbsup:
Kevin L: I can own SDK spec. Note on backwards compat: unknown profile -> prefer server-default + add a warning header rather than 400 to avoid breaking old clients.
Ashok R: I'll prototype a compact ID map and perf lookup. Quick config idea:
```yaml
profiles:
  - id: 21
    name: balanced-v2
    bitwidth: int8
    fallback_ids: [11, 31]
```
Sophie T: Shadow sampling plan: collect 5k requests/day per endpoint for at least 3 days before canary. Will post draft testcases in QA board.
Zach P: I'll wire telemetry and add cost_savings_pct to the infra dashboard. Also adding an autoscale hint: expected_gpu_cycles_saved per profile so SRE can adjust pools.
Maria G: Perfect. Tagging owners in thread: @Ashok R @Sophie T @Kevin L @Zach P. I'll spin up a short RFC follow-up doc with these items and assign owners.
